title: Iga Ueno Castle
scope: The 1935 main and small wooden keeps of Iga Ueno Castle, with the covered connecting gate and their visible stone plinths.
limitations: The placed model depicts the reconstructed pair of keeps and connecting entrance gate. The rest of the historic park, moat, ramparts and demolished premodern buildings are separate.
Historic stonework profile, small ornaments and precise window and roof tile details use medium-fidelity approximations.
